annotationPolicy.manualPolicy: tight-body bounding boxes around every visible adult ant

hashAlgorithms.annotationContentSha256: sha256 over sorted entries: labelFilename + NUL + labelFileSha256 + LF
hashAlgorithms.combinedFinalTestSha256: sha256 over sourceSha256, imageContentSha256, and annotationContentSha256 key/value lines
hashAlgorithms.detailedManifestSha256: sha256 of UTF-8 ground_truth_manifest.json bytes as committed
hashAlgorithms.imageContentSha256: sha256 over sorted entries: imageFilename + NUL + imageSha256 + LF

manualAnnotation.zeroAdultPolicy: explicit empty .txt required for reviewed-zero frames; none were present because every frozen frame has at least one manual ant box
